Subject: Payment route & procurement owner — next steps and draft SOW

Hi Sara — great call earlier today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

What we covered
- Redwood inference offering and Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs for your inference workloads
- Your procurement options: PO (preferred by you), corporate card, or via Cloud Marketplace
- Need to confirm procurement owner and expected approval timeline

Agreed action items
1) I will share a short procurement questionnaire to help procurement/legal validate technical controls and billing cadence (attached).
2) Please introduce your procurement/finance owner (name + email) so we can route any contract questions.
3) We’ll prepare a draft SOW + pricing appendix for Orbit to speed review.

Questions for you
- Do you expect a formal purchase order (PO) or would a credit card purchase be quicker for initial pilot?
- Any mandated terms (e.g., net-30, SOC2 evidence, IaaS marketplace requirements)?

Next meeting
- Can we schedule a short procurement sync next week (30 min) to walk through the questionnaire and owners? I’m proposing Tue 10/06 11:00am PT or Wed 10/07 9:00am PT — what works best?

Attaching: procurement-questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 page)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with Marissa to draft the SOW based on the notes.

Best,

From: Sara Patel <sara@orbitanalytics.com>

Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment route & procurement owner — next steps and draft SOW

Hi Karthik — thanks for the summary and the questionnaire. Quick answers from our side: 

- Procurement path: We prefer a PO for anything above $10k. For an initial pilot under that threshold we can do a corporate card, but PO is our default.
- Payment terms: Net-30 is standard for us; procurement/legal may ask for a few clause clarifications.
- Marketplace: We do use the Cloud Marketplace for some infra purchases. If Redwood is available there it could shorten internal approvals — but it's not required.

Procurement owner
- Anthony Ruiz (anthony.ruiz@orbitanalytics.com) is our procurement lead — I’ve cc’d him here. He’ll take the questionnaire and coordinate with legal.

Timing
- Anthony says legal will need roughly 7–10 business days to review a standard SOW + T&Cs. If you can get a clean SOW and pricing appendix to us this week, we’ll aim for a PO by ~10/25.

Attaching: procurement_requirements.pdf (pdf, 2 pages)

Happy to do Tue 10/06 11am PT — works for me and Anthony.

Best,
Sara Patel
Director of Platform Engineering | Orbit Analytics
sara@orbitanalytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Payment route & procurement owner — next steps and draft SOW

Karthik / Ben — forwarding Sara’s reply and procurement contact. Action items for us: 

- Ben: can you confirm finance’s stance on net-30 for RD-4762 and whether we can accept standard PO terms (or need any deviations)? If there are any approvals required for net-30, flag them now.
- Karthik: please prepare a concise SOW and pricing appendix that clearly states pilot scope, seat/throughput pricing, and contract term options. Aim to keep the doc to 1–2 pages.
- Also include a short marketplace note: what differences (billing flow, invoicing cadence) we have if Orbit buys via marketplace.

I’ll draft a short cover note for Anthony/legal that highlights SOC2 evidence and data isolation options for private deployments.

Thanks — let me know if you want me to own the procurement sync on Wed.

Marissa Cole

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Payment route & procurement owner — next steps and draft SOW

Hi Sara / Anthony — circling back on this thread to check where procurement is in the review and whether anything is blocking you from issuing a PO. We want to keep momentum.

I’ve attached a short draft SOW and our standard Commercial PSA for your legal to review — both are intentionally concise to speed the process. Highlights: 
- Pilot scope: 2 dedicated instances up to 4 concurrent sessions, 90-day pilot
- Pricing appendix: pilot price, post-pilot committed rates, and marketplace parity note
- Standard T&Cs: we flag data residency and audit log options; happy to redline specific clauses.

Proposed next steps
- 30-min procurement + legal sync (Anthony, me, Marissa) — Tue 10/13 11:00am PT or Thu 10/15 9:00am PT.
- If Anthony prefers to review in writing first, please indicate the key clause items you expect to need redlines so we can pre-empt them.

Attaching: SOW-draft.docx (docx, 1 page), Commercial-PSA-v1.pdf (pdf, 5 pages)

If you prefer, Marissa can run the sync — she’s on this thread.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Sara Patel <sara@orbitanalytics.com>

Hi Karthik / Marissa — quick update from procurement/legal: 

- Anthony has handed the SOW and PSA to legal for review. They expect to come back with a small set of redlines focused on indemnity and data processing language.
- We are still leaning toward a PO + Net-30 for the pilot since the estimated spend will be >$10k if we expand usage.
- Marketplace remains an option, but legal prefers a direct PO for better visibility on terms.

Next steps from our side
- Legal will send redlines by ~10/25. Anthony will follow up with a PO once legal signs off.
- If you can provide a short appendix that explains billing via marketplace vs direct PO (2–3 bullets), that will speed alignment.

Thanks again — Anthony and I will be on the 10/06 sync you scheduled; we’ll bring any questions there.

Sara
Director of Platform Engineering | Orbit Analytics
